goal: Adapt actual donor TD(0) learning and compare with matched MC and heuristic under Bonk rules; no LLM, phone, dependency install, default switch or publication

model.features: same4x4patterns/D4/stage0,1,2 as MC, clipped-linear with terminalgoal1/loss0

pool.selection: first64unique reachable first-cap snapshots in ascending seed; outcomes not used

training.curriculum: after2048episodes: index%4==0 cap1 pool, ==1 cap2 pool, ==2/3 fullstart; snapshot index=(seed xor(seed>>16))%pool_size
training.matched: MC and TD-teacher use identical teacher behavior, seeds, epsilon, starts and episode counts; trajectory_digest must match. Joint checkpoint selected by summed validation goal tuple, ties earliest. Both stop together after two non-improving checks, minimum3checks.
training.selfplay: TD0 teacher warmup2048, then TD0 greedy learned+epsilon using same curriculum; own validation checkpoint and two-stall stop, minimum3checks. Behavior differs from matched arms; no one-factor causal claim.
training.metric: lexicographic (full_goals,cap1_goals,cap2_goals), checkpoint selection uses validation only
training.stop: two consecutive non-improving validation checkpoints after at least3checks. If max131072 reached while improving, report budget-limited, never claim plateau; no tuning after screen/holdout
training.resume: full config/source/binary/pool hashes, exact seed prefix and model SHA; separate current and milestone models; no implicit rebuild or overwritten foreign checkpoint; rollback limit and halt

validation.scope: checkpoint tuning, initial cap boards shared with training pool; not independent full-game control

screen.order: rotate arms by seed, serial timed games
screen.selection: choose TD arm with most full goals, ties lower measured choose wall per completed move, then declared order. Promoted only if more screen goals than heuristic and at least matched MC and old MC. Freeze all models, runner, statistics and actual binaries before holdout; no further training

holdout.order: rotate three arms by seed, serial timed games
holdout.criterion: primary TD>heuristic and secondary TD>matchedMC; exact paired one-sided tests, eachp<=0.025 for joint confirmed improvement, no limits, screen promoted. Otherwise report each result without default adoption. No finalist reselection or tuning by holdout

cost: equal nominal10ms upper budget; measured search wall/move and total wall reported separately; no equal actual-cost claim unless within10percent
old_mc: experiments/learning/model.bin unchanged LR10 archive; separate historical baseline in screen only, not donor pretrained weights
limits: never label asloss; invalidate stage and halt, do not save partial trained weights
scope_limits: No global ML optimum or10second full-game win claim. Fixed seed range audits include available archives; unknown external seeds not asserted absent. Initial curriculum states originate in train-only pool. All models and negative results retained. Native10s diagnostics may be performed after freeze on prior fixed corpus, not used for selection.
